blurb: Guests can climb a 35-foot tower with 12 different routes suitable for ages 4 and up. They can race down dual ziplines totaling 1,221 feet over a prairie. The park offers app-powered scavenger hunts with trivia and photo challenges across their trails, as well as customized team bonding experiences for groups.
